writing.overall_comment: A well-organized but reference-style skill doc that is marred by typos ('Recommend Directory Structure', 'component components'), a broken final code fence, and examples lacking setup/import and failure-path detail.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately reflect the content, which genuinely covers Vue 3, Nuxt 3, Tailwind CSS, shadcn-vue, and Pinia as advertised.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The three code snippets are largely correct, but they omit needed auto-import context, show only a thin error path with no template error state, and the final composable block has a malformed/extra closing fence that breaks rendering.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The doc is a solid conceptual reference (stack, directory layout, best practices, patterns) but offers no explicit setup or execution steps, so a reader cannot act on it without outside knowledge.

suggestions: Fix the malformed/extra closing fence in the final composable block so the code sample renders correctly.
Add an explicit setup-and-execution section with dependency install, configuration, and run commands near the beginning or after the directory layout to make the doc actionable.
In the three code snippets, include the missing auto-import context and add a visible template-level error state to the error-handling example.
